reuseForeignUid.detail: state directory is owned by uid 1000, not the daemon's uid 12345; refusing to reuse the credential inside it

reuseNoUid.detail: existing credential cannot be verified: this platform reports no process uid

file0644.detail: existing credential file mode 0644 grants group or other access; another user may hold the token (chmod 600 to repair, or delete it to mint afresh)

dir0777.detail: state directory mode 0777 is group- or other-writable; another user could replace the credential (chmod 700 to repair)

empty.detail: existing credential file is empty; delete it to mint a fresh credential deliberately

symlinkFile.detail: credential path refused by state-write boundary (symlink-escape): real location <SCRATCH>/cred/elsewhere.token leaves the state directory <SCRATCH>/cred/symlink-file

danglingSymlink.detail: existing credential file is a symbolic link; refusing to read a token through it

directoryAtFile.detail: existing credential file is not a regular file

symlinkStateDir.detail: state directory is a symbolic link or not a directory; refusing to reuse the credential inside it
